answer: Trace where each account's first coins came from. Every new wallet is opened with funds sent by some earlier wallet, and following that lineage back, the way streams run down one ridge to a common lake, exposes shared roots. Accounts whose funding traces to one source share a single payout cap, so fifty names earn no more than one. To escape the merge, each fake needs its own independent funding path from unrelated honest payers, a cost that grows with every clone. Seen through this prism, a gale of sign-ups fed from one purse stands out.
